# Shop roadmap

## Release plan
R1 (Q1 2027): place order and card payment, SHOP-398.
R2 (Q2 2027): order history and refunds, SHOP-405.
R2 must support refunds through Payments.
Release 2.3 hardening: performance and bug fixes, SHOP-420.

## Milestones
2027-03-31: R1 in production.
2027-06-30: R2 in production.
